title: Dotfield
summary: A browser strategy game exploring territory control, tactical geography and computer opponents.
content:
I am developing Dotfield as a compact territory-control strategy game. Players move troops between cities, expand their territory and compete against computer-controlled factions.

Geography and commitment

Generated fields explore how mountains, rivers and bridges shape movement and staging decisions. Different city roles introduce trade-offs between production, defence and transport.

Iterating on the rules

The project combines a shared simulation with AI forecasts, saved rounds and responsive browser controls. Mechanics and balance are still evolving; this case study describes an ongoing project rather than a finished, balanced release.
